filters.user_directory: id = :requester OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.account = :requester) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages m JOIN conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation WHERE m.author = user_directory.id AND m.internal = 0 AND m.deleted = 0 AND c.kind = 'support' AND c.visitor = :requester)
filters.conversations: ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.account = :requester) AND (conversations.kind IN ('public_channel','support') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memberships cm WHERE cm.conversation = conversations.id AND cm.account = :requester AND cm.active = 1))) OR (conversations.kind = 'support' AND conversations.visitor = :requester))
filters.memberships: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.account = :requester) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conversations c WHERE c.id = memberships.conversation AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.account = :requester) AND (c.kind IN ('public_channel','support') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memberships cm WHERE cm.conversation = c.id AND cm.account = :requester AND cm.active = 1))) OR (c.kind = 'support' AND c.visitor = :requester)))
filters.messages: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conversations c WHERE c.id = messages.conversation AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.account = :requester) AND (c.kind IN ('public_channel','support') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memberships cm WHERE cm.conversation = c.id AND cm.account = :requester AND cm.active = 1))) OR (c.kind = 'support' AND c.visitor = :requester))) AND (messages.internal = 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.account = :requester))
filters.attachments: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages m WHERE m.id = attachments.message AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conversations c WHERE c.id = m.conversation AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.account = :requester) AND (c.kind IN ('public_channel','support') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memberships cm WHERE cm.conversation = c.id AND cm.account = :requester AND cm.active = 1))) OR (c.kind = 'support' AND c.visitor = :requester))) AND (m.internal = 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.account = :requester)) AND m.deleted = 0)
filters.reactions: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages m WHERE m.id = reactions.message AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conversations c WHERE c.id = m.conversation AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.account = :requester) AND (c.kind IN ('public_channel','support') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memberships cm WHERE cm.conversation = c.id AND cm.account = :requester AND cm.active = 1))) OR (c.kind = 'support' AND c.visitor = :requester))) AND (m.internal = 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.account = :requester)) AND m.deleted = 0)
filters.read_receipts: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages m WHERE m.id = read_receipts.message AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conversations c WHERE c.id = m.conversation AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.account = :requester) AND (c.kind IN ('public_channel','support') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memberships cm WHERE cm.conversation = c.id AND cm.account = :requester AND cm.active = 1))) OR (c.kind = 'support' AND c.visitor = :requester))) AND (m.internal = 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.account = :requester)) AND m.deleted = 0) AND (account = :requester OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages m JOIN conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation WHERE m.id = read_receipts.message AND c.kind IN ('dm','support')))
filters.inbox: account = :requester AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages m WHERE m.id = inbox.message AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conversations c WHERE c.id = m.conversation AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.account = :requester) AND (c.kind IN ('public_channel','support') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memberships cm WHERE cm.conversation = c.id AND cm.account = :requester AND cm.active = 1))) OR (c.kind = 'support' AND c.visitor = :requester))) AND (m.internal = 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.account = :requester)) AND m.deleted = 0)
filters.changes: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conversations c WHERE c.id = changes.conversation AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.account = :requester) AND (c.kind IN ('public_channel','support') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memberships cm WHERE cm.conversation = c.id AND cm.account = :requester AND cm.active = 1))) OR (c.kind = 'support' AND c.visitor = :requester))) AND (changes.internal = 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.account = :requester))
filters.audit_log: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.account = :requester AND t.is_admin = 1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conversations c WHERE c.id = audit_log.conversation AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.account = :requester) AND (c.kind IN ('public_channel','support') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memberships cm WHERE cm.conversation = c.id AND cm.account = :requester AND cm.active = 1))) OR (c.kind = 'support' AND c.visitor = :requester))) AND (audit_log.internal = 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.account = :requester))
